items.summary: Wisconsin WEDC の Qualified New Business Venture(Investor Tax Credit)により、ミルウォーキー市の The Way Out, Inc.(NAICS 624310・社会福祉サービス業)に$3.0Mの投資税額控除が承認され、予定投資額は$400kとされている。
items.verbatim: WEDC Investor Tax Credit under the Qualified New Business Venture program, awarded 2022-10-10 to a recipient in City of Milwaukee, Milwaukee County. Industry: Health Care (NAICS 624310). Award amount: $3,000,000. Planned project cost: $400,000.
